SELECT MAX(inv.id) as inventoryId, pi.spu_no as spuNo, pi.category as category, pd.id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.images_url as productImgUrl, pd."name" as productName, inv.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wh."name" as warehouseName, COALESCE(wl.code,'') as warehouseLocation, COALESCE(wlt.code,'') as warehouseArea, COALESCE(wlt."name",'') as warehouseAreaName, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status ='usable' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) as usableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.dict_inventory_status ='frozen' THEN inv.qty ELSE 0 END) as frozenQty, inv.org_id as orgId, MAX(tf.trade_time) as latestSalesTime FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi on pd.product_id = pi."id" and pi.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN inventory inv on pd.id = inv.sku_id and inv.is_deleted = false AND inv.dict_inventory_status IN ( 'usable', 'frozen' ) LEFT JOIN warehouse wh on inv.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wl on inv.warehouse_location = wl.code and wl.is_deleted = false AND wl.warehouse_id = inv.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wlt on wl.parent_id = wlt.id and wlt.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN (select inventory_id, max(trade_time) as trade_time from transaction_flow where is_deleted=false
AND trade_time >= #{params.saleTimeList[0]} and (#{params.saleTimeList[1]}) > trade_time
group by inventory_id) as tf on inv.id = tf.inventory_id where pd.is_deleted = false and wh.disabled = false and wl.is_deleted = false and wlt.is_deleted = false and wh.approve_status = 'approve' and pi.property not in ('服务','费用') and pd.status = 2 AND inv.org_id is not null
and tf.trade_time is not null
AND inv.warehouse_id IN
#{item}
AND pi.spu_no IN
#{item}
AND pi.category_id IN
#{item}
AND pd.sku_no IN
#{item}
AND (pd.name ILIKE concat('%', #{params.skuStr}::text ,'%') or pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%', #{params.skuStr}::text ,'%'))
GROUP BY spuNo,category,skuId, skuNo, productImgUrl,productName,warehouseId,warehouseName,warehouseLocation,warehouseArea,warehouseAreaName,inv.org_id ORDER BY skuNo ASC,warehouseName ASC, inventoryId ASC

select wh.id, wh.create_user_name AS createUserName, wh.create_time AS createTime, wh.name, wh.type_id AS typeId , wh.charge_id AS chargeId, wh.contacts, wh.contact_tel_number AS contactTelNumber, wh.disabled, wh.address, wh.warehouse_manage_type AS warehouseManageType, wh.geography_location AS geographyLocation, wh.org_id AS orgId, wh.kingdee_warehouse_code AS kingdeeWarehouseCode, wh.is_virtual AS isVirtual, wh.approve_status AS approveStatus, wh.is_enable_location as isEnableLocation from warehouse wh where wh.is_deleted = false
and ((wh.kingdee_warehouse_code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or wh.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and wh.approve_status = #{params.approveStatus}
and wh.disabled = #{params.disabled}
order by
case when wh.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when wh.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when wh.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , wh.name,
wh.kingdee_warehouse_code asc

#{item}
